title: Operations Supervisor
description_text:
Our client is an established international financial services company specialising in trade finance, forfaiting, and related financial products. With an international presence and operations across several key financial markets, the company offers a professional environment with opportunities for long-term career development. 
 Position Summary
 Our client is looking for a highly organised, motivated, and detail-oriented Supervisor to join the Operations team in Malta.
 The successful candidate will support the administration and execution of trade finance transactions, ensure compliance with internal procedures, prepare operational and management reports, and contribute to process improvements and operational projects.
 Key Responsibilities
Administer and oversee trade finance transactions throughout their lifecycle, ensuring accuracy and timely execution.
Review and verify transaction documentation in line with internal policies and procedures.
Prepare and review contracts, pricing letters, confirmations, insurance documentation, and other transaction-related documents.
Coordinate settlements, repayments, fee collections, and other operational activities.
Maintain accurate transaction records and update internal systems.
Conduct due diligence and screening checks on counterparties and transactions.
Prepare management, portfolio, and operational reports.
Support the implementation of new products, systems, projects, and operational initiatives.
Identify opportunities to improve processes, controls, and procedures.
Provide guidance and day-to-day support to junior team members when required.
Liaise with external professional advisors, legal representatives, and other counterparties.
Perform any other duties reasonably assigned by management.
 Requirements
Minimum of 5 years of experience in banking, trade finance, financial services, or a similar operational environment.
Previous experience in trade finance, syndicated lending, loan administration, credit insurance, or related financial products will be considered a strong advantage.
At least 3 years of relevant experience in trade finance or a related area is highly desirable.
Strong analytical skills and excellent attention to detail.
Proven ability to manage multiple transactions and priorities simultaneously.
Excellent organisational and time management skills.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Microsoft Excel, Word, and Outlook.
Fluency in written and spoken English.
Proactive approach with a willingness to learn and develop professionally.
 What Our Client Offers
Comprehensive on-the-job training.
Opportunities for professional development and career progression.
International working environment.
Long-term career opportunities within an established organisation.
Competitive remuneration package based on qualifications and experience.
 Join Our Client's Team
 If you have experience in banking or financial services and are looking for an opportunity to develop your career within an international organisation, apply today and take the next step in your professional journey.
